name: path-scout
description: Extract, resolve, and validate file and directory paths mentioned in text, with variable expansion, ignore rules, hidden-file control, and configurable search roots.

scripts.build: tsdown src/index.ts --clean --no-dts --format esm --platform node --sourcemap --tsconfig tsconfig.json && tsc --project config/tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck
scripts.prepack: bun run check && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.test: bun run build && node --test "quality/test/*.test.mjs" && bun test quality/test
